title: もみじ (Momiji — Autumn Leaves)
description: A beautiful 1911 song about autumn foliage in the Japanese mountains. The first verse paints maples and ivy decorating the mountain slopes like the hem of a kimono. The second verse shows scattered leaves floating on a stream, their reds and yellows weaving a living brocade on the water's surface.
